While the script assumes the presence of certain files (`exodus.desktop`) and does not sanitize all inputs (e.g., `PWD` could theoretically contain malicious characters), these are minor hygiene issues, not evidence of malice. The behavior aligns with legitimate post-extraction setup scripts used by self-contained desktop applications distributed as binaries.
